name: Masala Indian & Bistro
kurzbeschreibung:
**Masala Indian & Bistro in Kufstein**

Discover authentic Indian flavors and cozy bistro vibes in the heart of **Kufstein**. Whether you're craving fiery curries, fragrant biryanis, or a comforting bowl of dal, our menu offers a taste of India’s rich culinary traditions. Pair your meal with a refreshing **Lassi** or a crisp **Kingfisher beer**—perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes.

For a lighter bite, indulge in our fresh salads, crispy **Samosa**, or a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** twist with an Indian twist. Don’t miss our signature **Tandoori** dishes, slow-cooked in our traditional clay oven for that smoky, tender perfection.

We’re located just a short stroll from **Kufstein Fortress**, making us the ideal spot to refuel before or after your adventure. Come taste the world—one bite at a time!
